_comment: Curated-list entries for ops/lists/prepare.py. Formats taken from each list's README / CONTRIBUTING / PR template on 2026-10-10. One PR per list, ever.

targets.why: Swift-only list with fast merges; best fit.

edits.entry: - [Markdown Editor](https://github.com/Chr15t1an/markdown-editor) - Native Markdown editor that renders formatting inline as you type and opens any folder as a sidebar file tree.
- [Markdown Editor](https://github.com/Chr15t1an/markdown-editor) - 原生 Markdown 编辑器，输入时即时渲染格式，并可将任意文件夹作为侧边栏文件树打开。

targets.pr_body:
Adds Markdown Editor to **Editors › Markdown** in README.md and README.zh.md.

**[Markdown Editor](https://markdown.chri5tian.com/)** (https://github.com/Chr15t1an/markdown-editor) is a free, MIT-licensed, native macOS Markdown editor (Swift/AppKit, no Electron or web view). Markdown renders inline as you type — one pane, no preview toggle, including GitHub pipe tables — and any folder you drop on it opens as a sidebar file tree of plain `.md` files. Apple Silicon, macOS 15+.

Disclosure: I'm the author of Markdown Editor. This entry and PR text were prepared with AI assistance and checked against the list's contribution guidelines.
